Publish.LongDescription:
# Intersection & Lane Markings (Beta)
## Please read first **This is my personal mod.** It is based on **Town Road Lane** by mxerf (GPL-3.0) and edited to fit my own needs. I share it in case it is useful to someone else, but: - It is a **beta**. Not everything has been tested in-game, and I am not sure how all of it works in every case. - **Use it at your own risk.** Back up your saves before trying it. Markings made with it may not load in other or older versions of the mod. - Support and updates come when I have time. Bug reports are welcome on GitHub, but I can't promise fixes.
All credit for the original mod goes to mxerf and Town Road Lane, and for the marking assets to G87.
## What it is A road-marking editor for intersections plus automatic lane markings for ordinary town roads.
## Marking editor Click any intersection — or the middle of a road — and draw your own markings: - **Lines** between anchor dots — solid, dashed (short / normal / long), double solid, a vanilla yellow set (solid / dashed / double / solid + dashed), G87 white or yellow styles, and a curb line, with adjustable curvature and per-segment visibility. Dots sit on every lane boundary, on the carriageway edge (including past parking lanes), and in a "setback" row 8 m before the junction — for the solid no-lane-change stretch in front of the stop line. Optional extras (on by default): a dot in the centre of every lane, and extra setback rows at 4 m and 16 m. - **Edit mode** — click a line and drag its two blue handles on the road to shape it, Move It-style; drag free points to move them. **Add point** splits a line in the middle with a new point you can drag. Only what can be edited is shown, so the anchor dots stay out of the way. - **Free draw** (**F**) — click anywhere on the junction or its roads to place your own points and draw through them. Right-click a free point to remove it. - **Mid-road editing** — click the middle of a road to draw lines, areas and free points along it, with anchor rows every 10 m. - **Area fills** over any polygon you outline — points snap to lane endpoints, kerb corners and line crossings, edges follow line curvature. Junction box (yellow box / waffle), white or yellow hatching, green bike lane, red bus lane, concrete, grass, sand, pavement, tiles, asphalt patch (needs the separate "G87 Vanilla Asphalt Pavement" mod). Area mode stays on after closing an area, so you can outline the next one straight away. - **Hide vanilla markings** per intersection to start from a clean slate. - **Pin favourite styles** — star any entry in a style dropdown to keep it at the top of every list. - **Undo / redo** (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y or the panel buttons) for every marking edit. - In-game panel in the game's own style: tabs (Lines, Areas, Points, Advanced), option rows for mode, placement, style and snapping, a help card with the mouse controls, and undo / redo in the footer. Hotkeys: **Ctrl+M** toggle tool, **Y** cycle line style, **A** area mode, **U** cycle area fill, **F** draw anywhere, **Ctrl+Z** / **Ctrl+Y** undo / redo.
## Automatic markings Ordinary city roads with 3 m lanes get proper edge lane markings — the same way highways do — so parking, sidewalks and stops react correctly. Parking lane markings included. In North American-theme cities, one-way and divided roads (highways included) also get the US-style yellow line along the left, median-side edge — optional, on by default; European themes are unaffected.
## Known limitations - **The mod is purely visual.** Markings never affect how vehicles actually drive. To change real lane behavior use the Traffic mod (by krzychu124) — set up lane connections and directions there first, then draw your markings to match. The two mods don't sync automatically. - **Markings snap to anchor dots by default.** The dots sit on real road geometry (lane boundaries, lane centres, carriageway edges, kerb corners, line crossings, plus the setback rows before the junction), which is why markings land exactly on the lanes in a few clicks. Free draw places points anywhere on the junction and its roads, but not off the road surface — for markings elsewhere place the G87 packs' decals and net-lanes by hand. - Lines drawn on the optional dots (lane centres, 4 m / 16 m rows) stay saved but are not drawn while that option is off. - Nearly-tangent line contacts (well under ~8°) are treated as a graze rather than a crossing — no anchor dot appears at such touch points (by design; prevents jittery duplicate anchors). - Stretched junction connections (highway ramps/merges and other junctions where the road/junction boundary is not perpendicular to the road) can misplace the anchor dots relative to the painted lines. Fix: normalize the junction with the Node Controller mod so the connection cross-lines run perpendicular to the road — strongly recommended. The setback dot row 8 m before the junction also stays usable. - Area fill edges curve along a line only when that line was drawn with this mod. The game's own markings are not traced — along them the fill edge stays a straight segment between its points.
## How it works - The mod replaces the game's lane-marking generator (SecondaryLaneSystem) with a copy that adds its features; vehicles and traffic lanes are untouched. Mods that patch or replace the same system conflict with it; mods that add markings as their own decals or net-lanes (such as the G87 packs) do not. - After every game update the copy is compared with the new vanilla system before the next release (1.6.2 required no changes). - AI tools (Claude) were used heavily to develop this mod. Treat it as a beta: not every feature has been tested in-game. Full source on GitHub.
## Requirements The G87 marking packs and the [G87] Vanilla Curb pack ship as dependencies and install automatically — they supply the line styles, area fills and the curb texture. Huge thanks to G87 for the assets!
Publish.ChangeLog:
# 0.9.0 — first beta
First public beta of Intersection & Lane Markings (ILM): my personal edit of Town Road Lane 2.5.0 by mxerf (GPL-3.0), made to fit my own needs. Not everything is tested in-game. Use at your own risk and back up your saves.
New since Town Road Lane: - **Free draw** (F / panel): place your own points anywhere on the junction or its roads and draw through them; right-click a point to remove it. - **Mid-road editing**: click the middle of a road to draw lines, areas and free points along it, with anchor rows every 10 m. - **Edit mode** with curve handles: click a line and drag its two handles to shape it, drag free points to move them; **Add point** splits a line through a movable point. Only editable things are shown while editing, and only what the open tab edits can be picked: lines on the Lines tab, areas on the Areas tab, so you never grab the wrong one. Exactly what is highlighted under the cursor is what a click takes. - **New area drawing**: click anywhere on the road to place corners (they snap to nearby dots), then shape the area in Edit mode: drag corners, curve each side with handles, + adds a corner, right-click removes one. - **Point removal**: right-click a free point in any mode; areas using it only lose that corner instead of being deleted. - **Points tab**: a list of every free point you placed, with what uses it; hover a row to find the point on the road, remove points one by one or all unused ones at once. Points are dragged there without touching lines or areas. - **Snapping** with a snap bar like the game's: All, existing geometry, 90°, road side, guide lines and 0.5 m length steps, each on its own toggle. Works in free draw, area drawing and while dragging. - **Undo / redo** (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y and panel buttons) for every edit, per junction or road. - **Move It support**: lines, line crossings and area fills follow a road that is moved or reshaped. - **Wide line styles** (30 / 60 cm) for stop lines. - **Copy / paste and templates**: copy a junction's markings onto another junction with the same number of roads (turned to fit, Turn rotates them), or save them as named templates. - **Auto markings (test)**: guide lines along the lanes through junctions, following the Traffic mod's lane connections; on everywhere or per junction. - **Live editing**: markings follow the cursor while you drag handles, points and corners. - **New panel layout**: tabs for Lines, Areas, Points and Advanced, option rows like the game's tool options, a help card with the mouse controls for the current mode, junction settings on the Advanced tab and undo / redo in the footer. - English only for now; the translation support stays in place for later. - **More anchor points**: lane centre points and extra setback rows at 4 m and 16 m (both optional in Options, on by default). - **New panel** in the game's own style with a scrolling body; new lines and areas open automatically, and area drawing continues after closing an area. - Fixed a log flood in segment emission; the log level is now set explicitly (Debug only with VerboseLogging).
